items.why_en: Introduced a new Auto-rigging & Animation API, including quadruped auto-rigging, significantly expanding its AI 3D generation platform capabilities.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio 3D Editor + Canvas
items.why: 推出 3D 編輯器與畫布，為 AI 輔助的電影製作提供直接的 3D 場景控制，進一步整合了綁骨與動畫工作流程。
items.why_en: Launched 3D Editor + Canvas, providing direct 3D scene control for AI-assisted filmmaking, further integrating rigging and animation workflows.

items.name: Cascadeur
items.why: 引入了期待已久的動畫圖層（Alpha 版）、時間軸緩動控制及改進的環境自動擺姿，提升了 AI 輔助動畫的精確度與效率。
items.why_en: Introduced long-awaited animation layers (alpha version), timeline easing controls, and improved environmental AutoPosing, enhancing precision and efficiency in AI-assisted animation.

items.name: Armature Artists
items.why: 作為一款免費的 AI 輔助獨立綁骨與蒙皮工具，它能為各種形狀的 3D 角色和生物自動生成綁骨，並支援多種主流格式導出。
items.why_en: A free, AI-assisted standalone rigging and skinning tool that automatically generates rigs for 3D characters and creatures of all shapes, supporting multiple major export formats.

items.name: Tripo Animate Rig
items.why: 更新了其綁骨系統，改進了動畫重定向預設白名單驗證，提升了綁骨模型的兼容性和動畫流程的穩定性。
items.why_en: Updated its rigging system, improving animate retarget preset whitelist validation, enhancing compatibility and stability for rigged models in animation workflows.
